decided: When deciding whether a program is finished, a change or an exploration whose own record of the doc and stage it belongs to cannot be read is treated as belonging to no program, the way the program's stage list already treats it.
alternatives: treat any change whose record of the doc and stage it belongs to cannot be read as open work that keeps every program unfinished
stop and ask the user whenever such a record is found
why: Whether a program is finished is read from the same stage list the user sees in orbit architecture status, so the two must read each change the same way.
